reviews.comment:
Mejoro en relacion a como era antes.
Pero podria estar mucho mejor, deberia ser una ypf full con comida y demas, mejores mesas y sillas, una segunda caja de atencion,  y ahi si le daria 5 estrellas. Es una Estacion de renombre y considerando que es una parada obligada y concurre mucha gente, tanto locales como turistas.
La ultima vez que estuve (enero/2018) el cafe estaba malo y no tenian alfajores simples de la marca de color 'lila', solo triples. Muchos empleados y sin embargo un solo empleado atendiendo una larga cola de clientes.
Tampoco tenian ciertos combustibles.
Lo mejor que tienen son los baños.
Ojala mejoren aun mas. Aguante Garayalde!

(Translated by Google)
It's an improvement over how it used to be.

But it could be much better. It should be a full-service YPF with food and other amenities, better tables and chairs, a second checkout lane, and then I'd give it 5 stars. It's a well-known station, and considering it's a must-stop and frequented by many people, both locals and tourists.

The last time I was there (January 2018), the coffee was bad, and they didn't have the plain 'lilac' brand alfajores, only triple-layered ones. There were many employees, yet only one was serving a long line of customers. They also didn't have certain fuels.
The best thing about it is the restrooms.
I hope they improve even more. Long live Garayalde!
